actors.name: Head Teacher
actors.private_context: The head teacher is responsible for the Friday parent newsletter and decides its content. They are aware of the upcoming inspection but have not yet decided whether to address it in the newsletter.

actors.name: Three Parents
actors.private_context: The three parents are concerned about the upcoming inspection and have discussed it at drop-off. They hope the head teacher will address it in the newsletter but have not communicated this to the head teacher.

shared_context: Petersfield Primary School has an upcoming inspection. The head teacher publishes a Friday parent newsletter each week. The three parents raised the inspection at drop-off this week (week of 2026-09-22).

starting_events.description: The three parents discuss the upcoming inspection at drop-off.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the head teacher actually included a mention of the upcoming inspection in the Friday parent newsletter before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
